DeclaredBy: D6 identity-evidence declaration gate, from evidence already held
RecoveredFrom: artifacts/universe/identity-sample400.json, an untracked working artefact of the identity recovery exercise; this declaration is the tracked, sealed subset of it that is evidence rather than working note
Purpose: To state, for each member of the sealed 400-member universe, exactly what identity evidence is held, which source stated it, and what that evidence does and does not prove. It is evidence, not a resolver, and it creates no row anywhere.

SourceAuthority.VendorSeriesAttachment: eodhd, as a VendorSymbol claim only
PrecedenceChain: 1. issuer filing cover page, where a security title confirms the instrument  (sec-filing-recovered)
3. on disagreement between 1 and 2, EDGAR is accepted and the rejected value is kept as evidence (sec-conflict)
4. an EODHD delisted-list exact-name match is NEVER promoted                 (eodhd-only-provisional)
5. several candidates are REFUSED, never chosen                              (ambiguous)
6. no source names a symbol: the member is retained, unresolved              (unmatched)
SourceAuthority.PrecedenceOrigin: tests/AI.Investment.Api.Tests/IdentityResolution.cs, which already implements and tests this chain. This declaration restates it as the production precedence; it does not invent it.
SourceAuthority.WhyNotCik: A CIK identifies a legal entity. One entity may issue several securities, so a CIK can never be a Security identity (master-system-architecture-v1.md section 6.1).
SourceAuthority.WhyNotVendorTicker: An exact name match against a vendor delisted list names a symbol without establishing that it is the issuer tradable line. It lost every one of the 46 disagreements recorded here.
SourceAuthority.WhyNotTheSealedUniverseSymbolColumn: The universe declaration is authoritative for membership. Its symbol column is separately sourced and separately weak: 261 of 400 carry no symbol and 106 of the remainder are the vendor name-match route. A fingerprint over a file does not confer authority on every column in it.

Canonicalization.Cik: 10 digits, zero padded, as EDGAR states it
Canonicalization.IssuerStatedSymbol: upper case, vendor exchange suffix removed; a share-class or staleness marker is NEVER removed
Canonicalization.VendorSymbol: upper case, vendor suffix retained, because the suffix is part of the vendor key
Canonicalization.Rule: tests/AI.Investment.Api.Tests/IdentityResolution.cs Symbol(), which strips only the final dot-suffix. AIV-PA keeps its class marker because a preferred line and its common stock are different securities.

ValiditySemantics.TickerValidity: NOT EVIDENCED for any member. No held source dates a symbol change. Every SecurityIdentifierEvidence block therefore carries ValidFrom null, ValidTo null and ValidityIntervalEvidenced false.
ValiditySemantics.VendorSymbolValidity: Evidenced only as the extent of the vendor series held under that key. SeriesFirstBarDate and SeriesLastBarDate are facts about the vendor series and are NOT a claim that the instrument traded under that symbol on those dates.
ValiditySemantics.WhyTheyDiffer: The vendor back-fills a full history under the issuer current key. TBCH.US carries bars from 2021-09-01 although that security traded as HEAR across much of that window, and SNDA.US carries a split effective 2021-09-09 when it traded as CSU. A VendorSymbol assertion bounded by the series is true; a Ticker assertion bounded by it would be false.
ValiditySemantics.DocumentDateIsNotValidFrom: A filing cover page dates the statement, not the symbol validity. This declaration never converts a document date into a ValidFrom, and for these members no document date was recorded at all.
RequiredToEstablishAnInterval: a dated symbol-change event from an authoritative source, or
the filing accession number and filing date for each cover-page statement, which would bound a claim from below but still not from above, or
request-level provenance for the acquiring requests; provider_exchanges holds 0 rows against 2,274 ingestion runs and is recorded as not backfillable

Proves: Which CIK each member of the sealed universe is.
Which symbol an authoritative source stated for that issuer, and which source stated it.
Where a filing cover page was read, the security title it carried, for 90 of 400 members.
Which vendor series key is held for that member, and the extent of that series.
Which candidate symbol was rejected, by which source, and why it lost.
Which members have no security evidence at all, and which were refused as ambiguous.
DoesNotProve: When any symbol became or ceased to be correct. No validity interval is evidenced for any Ticker.
That an issuer has exactly one security. SecurityKind was recovered for 90 of 400; for the other 310 the evidence names one symbol and is silent about whether others exist.
That a vendor series key was the traded symbol on any date within the series.
Anything about a listing, a venue, a listing status or a listing date. No held source makes a listing claim.
That a member currently trades, or ever traded, on any particular venue.
That a rejected symbol was never correct: it is retained precisely because it may have been correct at another time.

IdentityChain.Production: Cik -> Company -> Security -> SecurityIdentifier -> Listing -> Venue

BoundariesThatEvidenceCannotCross.VendorSymbolToCompanyTicker: REFUSED. A vendor key is not an issuer statement.
BoundariesThatEvidenceCannotCross.VendorSymbolToSecurityIdentity: REFUSED automatically. A vendor series may be attached to a Security only through an identifier assertion whose source is the vendor and whose interval is the series extent.
BoundariesThatEvidenceCannotCross.CikToSecurityIdentity: REFUSED. One company may issue several securities.
BoundariesThatEvidenceCannotCross.SymbolChangeToNewSecurity: REFUSED. A symbol change is a new identifier assertion, not a new instrument.
BoundariesThatEvidenceCannotCross.CompanyToExactlyOneSecurity: REFUSED. Silence about other instruments is not a statement that there is one.
BoundariesThatEvidenceCannotCross.AnythingToListingOrVenue: REFUSED. No listing evidence is held, and a ListingEvent requires an effective date that nothing supplies.

PointInTimeContract.Today: Against this declaration alone, a Ticker-kind lookup at any asOfUtc returns Unresolved, because no Ticker assertion carries an interval. A VendorSymbol-kind lookup can return Resolved within the series extent once identifiers are persisted.
PointInTimeContract.Note: The contract is declared here so that the persistence stage implements it rather than inventing one. This declaration implements nothing.

SecurityIdentifierSemantics.Kind: Ticker for an issuer-stated market symbol; VendorSymbol for a vendor series key. The two are never written as the same kind.
SecurityIdentifierSemantics.Value: canonicalised as above; never a key, never a column
SecurityIdentifierSemantics.ValidFrom: required by the type; therefore no Ticker assertion may be persisted from this declaration until an interval is evidenced
SecurityIdentifierSemantics.ValidTo: null means no observed end, which is not an assertion that it runs forever
SecurityIdentifierSemantics.VendorSymbolIsNotTickerValidity: stated explicitly so that no future writer treats the series extent as a ticker interval
SecurityIdentifierSemantics.FutureImplementationRequirement: SecurityIdentifier persistence does not exist: SecurityConfiguration states builder.Ignore(s => s.Identifiers) and no identifier table exists in either database. One additive table is required. It is recorded here as a future requirement and is not implemented.

ListingVenueBoundary.VendorSymbol: belongs to SecurityIdentifier on Security, kind VendorSymbol, sourced to the vendor
ListingVenueBoundary.ListingStatus: belongs to ListingEvent, never to Listing, and is always qualified by venue
ListingVenueBoundary.EffectiveDates: belong to ListingEvent and are mandatory there
ListingVenueBoundary.SymbolChange: is a new SecurityIdentifier assertion, not a ListingEvent and not an edit
ListingVenueBoundary.EvidenceHeld: none. company.exchange is a current-state string on 591 subjects with no effective date, and the identity evidence carries an Exchange string for 349 members with no date. Neither can type a ListingEvent.

Provides: the accepted issuer-stated symbol per CIK, with its source and its resolution status
the vendor series key and extent against which the 95 held split facts are filed
the explicit record that a vendor key is not a point-in-time ticker
StillMissing: Security rows, and a writer to create them
a dated symbol-change chain, without which an as-of resolution for a renamed line cannot be computed
CorporateActionsDependency.AttachmentRule: A CorporateAction is addressed by SecurityId and VenueId. It is NEVER attached by ticker string equality.
CorporateActionsDependency.WhyEqualityFails: SNDA.US carries a split effective 2021-09-09 when that security traded as CSU; BIOR.US carries one effective 2023-01-03 when it traded as PROG. String equality would attach each to whatever now bears the symbol.

CoverageNote: The identity class describes the security-identity evidence only. Vendor series evidence is orthogonal and is recorded separately per member: a member may hold a vendor series while its security identity rests on EDGAR alone, and a member classified vendor-symbol-claim-only holds a vendor NAME MATCH and no series at all.

DisagreementNote: All 46 are disagreements against the EODHD delisted-list exact-name match. None involves an EDGAR-sourced symbol. ConflictClass is assigned only from signals the repository evidences: a preserved class marker in the rejected symbol, a substantive issuer-name divergence between the universe declaration and the identity evidence, or the vendor own staleness marker. Where none fires, the class is source-quality, which is the conservative reading. A finer reading appears in the D5 decision artifact and is deliberately NOT sealed here, because it rests partly on domain inference rather than on repository evidence.
NotationNote: One symbol in two notations, not a disagreement. 139 members carry a symbol in both the universe declaration and the identity evidence; 46 genuinely disagree and 93 agree once Symbol() is applied to both sides. Of those 93, these differ in raw notation. Applying Symbol() to only one side - the error in the Stage G re-gate - turned exactly 12 of them into false disagreements and produced the withdrawn figure of 58.

Survivorship: No member is dropped, replaced or excluded by this declaration. A member with no security evidence remains a member of the sealed universe, because membership is derived from cohort frames and never from the presence of prices or of an identity.
DigestRule: SHA-256, lower-case hex, over the newline-joined canonical form: schema, evidence base fingerprint, declared-at, then for each member in Cik order the newline-joined fields Cik, IdentityClass, ResolutionStatus, accepted symbol or empty, vendor symbol or empty, rejected symbol or empty.
